objective.name: e2e.env
objective.description: Tells what the back wrapper sees in one environment variable, as a digest.

#root.role: Tells what the back wrapper sees in one environment variable, as a digest.

transformation_contract.morphing: The name of a variable becomes whether the wrapper sees it and the digest of its value.
invariants: The capacity has no effect outside its reply.
The value itself is never returned.
failure: It fails only if the wrapper cannot run.
notes: End-to-end fixture for the secrets given to a wrapper.
